textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 maths · Fractions · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: When one whole is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit, also called a unit fraction. Examples are 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 and 1/100.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: When one whole is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit, also called a unit fraction. Examples are 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 and 1/100.
beats.speakEn: When one whole is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit, also called a unit fraction. Examples are 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/5 and 1/100.

beats.en: Equal parts must be equal in size, not necessarily equal in shape. A chikki cut into 6 equal pieces in different ways still gives pieces of 1/6 each, even though their shapes differ.
beats.speakEn: Equal parts must be equal in size, not necessarily equal in shape. A chikki cut into 6 equal pieces in different ways still gives pieces of 1/6 each, even though their shapes differ.

type: Key Concept: When one whole is divided into several equal parts, each part is called a fractional unit,
Rule: Equal parts must be equal in size, not necessarily equal in shape.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 maths · Fractions · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The distance from 0 to 1 is one unit. Dividing it into 4 equal parts marks 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4, and the last point is 1 itself. Each fraction is a length from 0.

beats.en: The distance from 0 to 1 is one unit. Dividing it into 4 equal parts marks 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4, and the last point is 1 itself. Each fraction is a length from 0.
beats.speakEn: The distance from 0 to 1 is one unit. Dividing it into 4 equal parts marks 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4, and the last point is 1 itself. Each fraction is a length from 0.

beats.en: A fraction like 7/4 has a numerator larger than its denominator. It is more than 1 because 4/4 makes a whole and 3/4 more remains, so 7/4 = 1 and 3/4. Such a number is called a mixed fraction.
beats.speakEn: A fraction like 7/4 has a numerator larger than its denominator. It is more than 1 because 4/4 makes a whole and 3/4 more remains, so 7/4  equals  1 and 3/4. Such a number is called a mixed fraction.

type: The distance from 0 to 1 is one unit. Dividing it into 4 equal parts marks 1/4, 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4,
A fraction like 7/4 has a numerator larger than its denominator.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 maths · Fractions · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Different fractions can name the same amount. Folding a strip, 1/2 is the same length as 2/4 and 4/8. Multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same number gives an equivalent fraction.
